info_about_intro: We build a straightforward, self-paced learning platform where instructors publish real courses and learners make steady progress at their own speed.
info_about_story_p1: {name} started from a simple frustration: most online courses either move too slowly to be worth the time, or move so fast that they leave real understanding behind. We wanted to build something different - courses taught by people who actually do the work they teach, organized around outcomes instead of just video runtime.
info_about_story_p2: Every course on the platform is built around a clear set of skills a student should walk away with, backed by real projects rather than passive watching. That philosophy shapes everything from how we vet instructors to how we structure a single lesson.
info_about_mission_body: Make practical, high-quality education accessible to anyone with the motivation to learn, regardless of where they are starting from.
info_about_vision_body: A world where a learner's skills - not their credentials or connections - determine the opportunities available to them.
info_about_value_outcomes_body: We measure success by what students can actually do, not just how many hours of video they watched.
info_about_value_students_body: Every product and content decision starts with what genuinely helps students learn and finish.
info_about_value_practical_body: Courses are built around real projects and real problems, not abstract theory disconnected from practice.
info_about_value_instructors_body: Every instructor is vetted for real-world experience, not just presentation skills.
info_about_philosophy_body: We believe people learn by doing, not by watching. Every course is built around projects and exercises that mirror real work, so what you practice is what you will actually use.
info_about_methodology_body: Courses are self-paced with structured sections and lessons, so you can move quickly through what you already know and slow down where you need it.
info_about_timeline_year1_body: Started with a small catalog and a simple goal: make high-quality, practical education accessible online.
info_about_timeline_year2_body: Expanded to a global network of industry instructors across engineering, design, data, and business.
info_about_timeline_year3_body: Introduced certificates of completion so students could show what they learned to employers.
info_about_timeline_today_body: Courses spanning web development, cloud, security, data, design, and business, taught by real practitioners.
info_leader_joel_bio: Started the academy after years of building internal training programs and wanting to make that quality of education available to anyone.
info_leader_hannah_bio: Leads curriculum quality and works directly with instructors to make sure every course meets a consistent bar before it goes live.
info_leader_ravi_bio: Builds the platform students and instructors use every day, with a focus on speed, reliability, and accessibility.
info_leader_maria_bio: Runs the support and community team, making sure students get help quickly and stay motivated to finish what they start.

info_help_still_body: Check our full FAQ list or reach out to our team directly.
info_help_getting_started_a1: Sign up with your email and password, or use Google sign-in for a faster setup. You can start browsing the catalog immediately, even before verifying your email.
info_help_getting_started_a2: Use the search bar or browse by category from the Courses page. Each course page shows the full curriculum, requirements, and what you will learn before you enroll.
info_help_getting_started_a3: Every course is individually priced by its instructor. Free courses grant instant access; paid courses walk you through checkout before you can start learning.
info_help_account_a1: You can update your name and profile details from the Profile page in your dashboard at any time.
info_help_account_a2: Update your password from your account settings, or use the "Forgot password" flow from the sign-in page if you are locked out.
info_help_account_a3: Contact our support team through the Contact page if you would like your account closed, and we will guide you through the process.
info_help_auth_a1: You can create an account or sign in using Google in one click, without setting a separate password for the platform.
info_help_auth_a2: After registering, check your inbox for a verification link. Verifying your email secures your account and unlocks certain account actions.
info_help_auth_a3: Use the "Forgot password" link on the sign-in page. You will receive a secure reset link by email that expires after a short period for your security.
info_help_courses_a1: Open any course page and select enroll. Free courses grant immediate access; paid courses take you through checkout first.
info_help_courses_a2: Your progress is calculated from the mandatory lessons you complete in a course. Completed lessons are always saved - you will never lose progress by leaving and coming back later.
info_help_courses_a3: Instructors occasionally update lessons to keep content current. Updates to a published course are reflected automatically for everyone already enrolled.
info_help_payments_a1: When you enroll in a paid course, you will see the price, any active discount, and payment instructions before you confirm.
info_help_payments_a2: If a course has an active promotion, enter your code at checkout to see the discounted price applied before you complete enrollment.
info_help_payments_a3: Refund requests are reviewed by our support team on a case-by-case basis. Reach out through the Contact page with your enrollment details.
info_help_certificates_a1: Courses that offer a certificate of completion are clearly marked on their course page before you enroll.
info_help_certificates_a2: Completing every mandatory lesson in a certificate-enabled course triggers your certificate of completion automatically.
info_help_certificates_a3: Once earned, your certificates are available from your student dashboard alongside the course you completed.
info_help_security_a1: We use industry-standard practices to protect your account, including secure password storage and encrypted connections throughout the platform.
info_help_security_a2: We will never ask for your password by email. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from us, report it through the Contact page.
info_help_security_a3: Use a strong, unique password and keep your email account secure, since it is used for password resets and account verification.
info_help_learning_a1: Every course is self-paced. There are no deadlines - progress is saved automatically so you can pause and resume whenever you like.
info_help_learning_a2: Save courses you are interested in to your wishlist so you can find them again later without searching the catalog from scratch.
info_help_learning_a3: Where an instructor has attached downloadable resources to a lesson, you can access them directly from that lesson.
info_help_troubleshooting_q1: A lesson video will not play
info_help_troubleshooting_a1: Try refreshing the page or switching browsers first. If the issue continues, let us know through the Contact page with the course and lesson name.
info_help_troubleshooting_q2: I can't sign in to my account
info_help_troubleshooting_a2: Double check your email and password, or use "Forgot password" to reset it. If you signed up with Google, use the Google sign-in button instead.
info_help_troubleshooting_q3: My progress does not look right
info_help_troubleshooting_a3: Completed lessons are never marked incomplete again, so this is usually a display refresh issue. Reload your dashboard, and contact support if the problem persists.
info_help_support_a1: Use the Contact page for any question we have not answered here - our team responds to every message.
info_help_support_a2: You can check the current platform status from the System status link in the site footer.
info_help_support_a3: Found something broken? Let us know through the Contact page with as much detail as possible - the page you were on and what you expected to happen.
